source.version: abstract only (Crossref and OpenAlex records for DOI 10.1142/s1363919626500210; identical text in Semantic Scholar). Journal article, International Journal of Innovation Management vol. 30, issue 03n04, published May 2026; closed access, no full text on file.
source.title_on_document: A Topic Modelling-Driven Systematic Mapping of Generative AI and Creativity Research: Toward a Conceptual Framework

paper_design_summary: The authors run a topic-modelling systematic mapping review of 61 peer-reviewed English-language publications on generative AI and creativity (2023 to June 2025). Latent Dirichlet Allocation on titles, abstracts, and keywords yields 20 topics grouped into five thematic clusters, and the authors propose a GenAI-Creativity Interaction Framework. The abstract reports no pooled effect estimates.
